llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only CEO/advisory guide whose files and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose and request no elevated privileges, credentials, installs, or external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (CEO guidance) match the included files (strategy.md, board.md, decisions.md, operations.md). The materials and checklists are appropriate for an executive-advice skill; there are no extraneous requirements (no binaries, env vars, or unrelated capabilities).

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the included documents confine the agent to advisory tasks (strategy, board prep, hiring, crises). They reference only the bundled markdown files and do not instruct reading system files, accessing environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints. Human-in-the-loop guidance is explicitly required for high‑risk actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present; this is instruction-only so nothing will be written to disk or downloaded during install. This is the lowest-risk model for a skill of this type.

llm.guidance: This skill is a plain, instruction-only CEO/advisory guide and appears internally consistent. It does not request credentials or install anything, so the technical risk is low. However: (1) advice here is generic and not a substitute for legal, financial, or HR counsel—use human experts for high‑stakes actions (executive firing, M&A, fundraising terms); (2) any confidential company data you share with the agent to get tailored recommendations could be sensitive—avoid pasting secrets, full financial statements, or investor terms unless you trust how the agent stores/transmits conversation data; (3) if you prefer to limit autonomous agent behavior, keep the skill user-invocable only or disable autonomous model invocation in your agent settings. Overall this skill is coherent and appropriate for its stated purpose.
